text: FOL ::: ∀x (BalancedDiet(x) ∧ IncludesVarietyOfFruitsVegetablesAndLeanProteins(x) → ProvidesEssentialNutrients(x) ∧ PromotesOverallHealthAndWellness(x)) ::: A balanced diet that includes a variety of fruits, vegetables, and lean proteins can provide essential nutrients and promote overall health and wellness.
